scope: Budget-matched positional staleness ablation; not a paper reproduction
hypothesis: Initial-view content is retained in native sinks but old temporal positions may reduce its influence on revisits. Rephase canonical sink keys to immediately precede rolling history only on commanded overlap.
archive: Only six canonical initial keys; reuse native values; never modify persistent cache
trigger: After18 latent frames, final chunk pose within2 movement units and45 degrees of starting pose
evaluation: Native parity; unchanged prefix; complete video motion/revisit review; DINO/PSNR; memory and warm timing
failure_policy: Reject if apparent gains come from frozen motion, abrupt resets or lost control. Do not select based on endpoint similarity alone.
